sections.title: A simple first conversation
sections.content: You can combine the patterns from this unit into a short conversation: greet someone, ask their name, give your name, ask where they are from, and say where you are from. The main forms are *soy*, *eres*, me *llamo*, ¿*Cómo* te *llamas*? and ¿De *dónde* eres?.

items.english: My name is Meg. And you?
I am Carlos. I am from Hungary.

sections.content: Build the conversation one step at a time. You do not need a new sentence for every turn. Reuse the patterns you already know.
